title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional circuit-breaker thresholds
author: Lena Cho
release_notes: Fixes SLO enforcer backoff ordering and adjusts default circuit-breaker thresholds used in regional failover to prevent cascading failovers during transient infra noise.
description:
Context: During a recent regional incident we observed the SLO enforcer enter a tight backoff loop which, combined with aggressive circuit-breaker thresholds, caused cascading regional failovers and impact to Dedicated customers. This is an urgent hotfix to prevent recurrence by tightening backoff ordering semantics and increasing short-term CB thresholds while exposing a configurable grace period.

What this PR does: - Fixes a race in the SLO enforcer backoff ordering that could cause multiple concurrent backoff timers to reset incorrectly. - Adjusts default circuit-breaker thresholds used by the regional failover path to be slightly more permissive for short transient spikes. - Adds a configurable "regional_failover_grace_seconds" parameter with a conservative default and documents the rationale. - Adds regression tests that reproduce the backoff/race scenario and assert stable ordering.

Why: We need to avoid rapid slam-open/slam-close cycles of CBs that were observed during the incident and ensure failover decisions are stable for short-lived infrastructure noise. This reduces customer impact while we continue to tune capacity and autoscaling policies.

Checklist: - [x] Update enforcer backoff ordering implementation - [x] Add configuration option and default value - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Run CI and validate on staging cluster - [x] Ship hotfix to main and monitor

Testing: Unit tests added in tests/slo/enforcer_test.go covering ordering and race, integration test run on staging with synthetic spike shows no cascading failovers. CI initially failed due to a flaky timer in tests; fixed by using deterministic clock in tests.

Rollout plan: Squash-merge to main, short canary in staging, then deploy to regional controllers. Post-deploy: monitor SLO enforcer alerts and regional failover rate for 2 hours. If any unexpected regressions occur revert and engage on-call SRE.
